map.👓 镜框尺寸与瞳距计算器: 👓 Frame Size and Pupillary Distance Calculator
map.根据镜圈宽度A、鼻梁宽度DBL与瞳距PD，计算每眼移心量与所需最小镜片直径: From the lens rim width A, bridge width DBL and pupillary distance PD, compute the per-eye decentration and the minimum required lens diameter
map.📖 查看「镜框尺寸与瞳距计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Frame Size and Pupillary Distance Calculator User Guide"
map.几何中心距 = A + DBL（两镜圈几何中心间距）: Geometric center distance = A + DBL (distance between the geometric centers of the two rims)
map.单眼移心量 = (A + DBL) / 2 − PD / 2，正值表示向鼻侧(内: Per-eye decentration = (A + DBL) / 2 − PD / 2; a positive value means decentration toward the nose (in), a negative value toward the temple (out)
map.最小未切边片径 = ED + 2×|移心量| + 2mm 磨边余量: Minimum uncut lens diameter = ED + 2×|decentration| + 2 mm edging allowance
map.移心量过大需更大直径镜片或定制片，实际还需考虑散光轴位与棱镜移心。结果供配镜加工: Excessive decentration requires a larger diameter lens or a custom lens; in practice the astigmatism axis and prism decentration must also be considered. The result is a reference for lens processing.
map.📚 深度解析：镜架瞳距适配: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Frame and Pupillary Distance Fitting
map.配镜按双眼瞳距定光学中心距。: Set the optical center distance according to the binocular pupillary distance when making glasses.
map.镜架几何中心常与瞳距差需移心。: The frame's geometric center often differs from the pupillary distance and requires decentration.
map.移心误差致棱镜效应。: Decentration error causes a prismatic effect.
map.瞳距 PD=64mm、镜架几何中心距 70mm → 每片内移 (70−64)/2: Pupillary distance PD=64 mm, frame geometric center distance 70 mm → each lens decentered inward (70−64)/2=3 mm; if the prescription is not decentered it produces base-out prism.
map.每 1mm 移心、−3.00D 产生 0.3Δ 棱镜，超 2mm 明显视物偏斜，: Each 1 mm of decentration at −3.00D produces 0.3Δ of prism; beyond 2 mm there is noticeable image displacement, so precise decentration or a narrower frame is required.
map.为什么镜架要合瞳距？: Why must the frame match the pupillary distance?
map.光学中心不对准瞳孔会产生棱镜效应致视疲劳/斜看，PD 与架距差大必须移心或换架。: If the optical center is not aligned with the pupil, a prismatic effect causes eye strain and oblique viewing; when the difference between PD and frame distance is large you must decenter or change the frame.
map.单眼瞳距也要测？: Should the monocular pupillary distance also be measured?
map.要。双眼 PD 均分不总对，尤其脸不对称，渐进片必测单眼 PD 与高度。: Yes. Splitting the binocular PD evenly is not always correct, especially with facial asymmetry; for progressive lenses the monocular PD and height must be measured.
